title: Project Nebula
summary: A compound in the Colorado foothills near Golden that houses a creative headquarters, production business, neurodivergent retreat center, wedding venue, and infrastructure for Dan's children — funded primarily through grants and favorable loans, operating on a philosophy of sustainable abundance.

components.name: Nebula HQ
components.description: Matte black steel creative headquarters partially embedded in a hillside. Omnipresent AI, 3D printers, fabrication suite.

components.name: PitchBlack
components.description: Production business that creates the best version of everything, charges along the way, eventually gives it away freely.

components.name: Neurodivergent Retreat
components.description: Week-long programs in cabins. Rotating therapists and psychiatrists. Talent pipeline for PitchBlack.

components.name: Wedding Venue
components.description: Pole barn ceremony/reception space with cabin accommodations for destination events.

components.name: Sunday Experience
components.description: Weekly viral experience — bottomless mimosas and live-band karaoke.

components.name: Family Infrastructure
components.description: Land and infrastructure for Dan's children to build their own homes.

philosophy: Sustainable abundance — post-scarcity model where the best version of everything is eventually given away freely.
fundingStrategy: 90%+ through grants (neurodivergent education, agriculture, tourism) and favorable loans (USDA, etc.)
